lead.headline: Isaiah Likely Puts 50 in Sheev's Bank, Kenneth Walker Is Out, and Jeff Longwood Takes God Bless Vodka in the Toilet Bowl
lead.deck: Washington's 24-21 win left Sheev with about 50.5 banked, the most in the league, from Likely's 9-for-127 night and Jayden Daniels' three touchdowns. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 goes for 10-0 as a 43.4-point favorite over Ben Football Team, #StopAsianHate plays without Walker and with Cam Skattebo's 27 on the bench, and 2-7 God Bless Vodka is the upset pick over 2-7 Sheev.

upset.why: Sheev is a 34.3-point favorite, but 50.5 of its 157.0 is already banked from Isaiah Likely's 27.7 and Jayden Daniels' 22.8. The rest of the way, God Bless Vodka projects 122.7 to 106.5, with George Kittle, Chase Brown, Jameson Williams and Josh Downs in offenses implied for 25 or more, while Sheev starts Quinshon Judkins and Harold Fannin Jr. in Cleveland's 18.0.

intro: Thursday night I had the Giants minus 2.5, and Stefon Diggs took my money with 57 seconds left. Commanders 24, Giants 21, on a 32-yard touchdown that brimley gets to enjoy and I don't. Here's the bank, as best I can add it up from the box score: Sheev got about 50.5, the most in the league, and it's not close. Isaiah Likely went 9 for 127 and a touchdown, about 27.7, and Jayden Daniels threw for 249 and three touchdowns with two picks and 28 rushing yards, about 22.8. Very Naughty Boys, 0-9 and allergic to joy, banked about 39.5: J.J. McCarthy threw for 293 and ran for 34 (about 18.1), Antonio Williams caught two balls and one was a touchdown (12.2), and Austin Ekeler gave 9.2. brimley got 29.7 from Diggs (6 for 83 and the winner) and Malik Nabers (5 for 44). Malachi Fields gave ClutchJuice 9.2, Chig Okonkwo gave Send Nudes 6.4, and Devin Singletary gave Panic Trade Project one carry for three yards. The best Giant was Cam Skattebo, 18 carries, 78 yards, two touchdowns and 44 receiving yards, about 27.2 points, and he was on #StopAsianHate's bench. Of course he was.

Same system as always. Every Sunday and Monday starter gets the Vegas implied total for his offense, built from the spread and the total. I took VegasInsider's board and bet365's numbers as posted by Fox Sports on Friday, and checked both against DraftKings via CBS Sports. All three agree on every favorite. Where VegasInsider and bet365 were a half point apart I split the difference, so you'll see the Lions at -2.75, the Packers at -2.75, the 49ers at -4.25 and Bengals-Steelers at 49.25. Chargers-Ravens on Monday is Baltimore -4.5 with a 38.5 total on both Fox and CBS. Anybody ruled out on the final report projects zero, and that's three starters this week: Kenneth Walker III, T.J. Hockenson and Carnell Tate. Dallas Goedert is a zero because the Eagles are on bye, and Cade Klubnik is a zero because he isn't the Jets' starter, Geno Smith is. One more warning: lineups are as they stood when our data was pulled early Thursday. If you fixed your team since then, your line moved and I don't know it yet.

The board in one breath. San Francisco is implied for 30.0 in Dallas, in the biggest total of the week, 55.75, and Dallas gets 25.75 of it. Buffalo is 29.25 against the Jets, Jacksonville 28.5 in Tennessee, Detroit 26.5 against New England in the early game in Munich, and Cincinnati 26.4 against Pittsburgh on Sunday night. The sewer: Arizona at 15.0 against the Rams with Gardner Minshew II hurt, the Raiders and the Chargers at 17.0, Miami at 17.5 with Kyle McCord at quarterback, and Cleveland and Tennessee at 18.0. Philadelphia, Chicago, Denver and Tampa Bay are on bye.

sections.note: Bijan Your Face 🍆💦. Six starters in offenses implied for 25 or more, both quarterbacks in the two fattest numbers on the board, and Ben has a dead tight end slot.
p: First place against third. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 is 9-0 and scores 184.9 a game, the best in the league by 10.4. Ben Football Team is 6-3 with a luck factor of +2.45, the luckiest in the league, and scores 119.4, seventh. Bijan projects 170.7 to 127.3, a 43.4-point favorite in the biggest total on the board, 298.0. Neither team has a Thursday point in the bank. Clean fight.

Bijan's case is the environment. Josh Allen (26.27) gets the Jets with Buffalo implied for 29.25. Christian McCaffrey (22.22) is in San Francisco's 30.0, and Dak Prescott (18.68) and Ryan Flournoy (9.05) are on the other side of that same game in Dallas's 25.75. That's Bijan owning both ends of a 55.75 total, which is the closest thing to a free roll I've seen since my cousin's wedding. Amon-Ra St. Brown (19.49) is questionable with the ribs, played through them last week, and gets New England with Detroit implied for 26.5. Tee Higgins (17.15) is in Cincinnati's 26.4 on Sunday night. Six starters in 25-plus offenses. Nobody else on the board has more than five.

Ben's problem is a hole. T.J. Hockenson is out with the wrist and chest and, as of Thursday's lineup, he's still sitting in the flex at zero. The fix is on Ben's own bench: Emmett Johnson is Kansas City's workhorse now that Kenneth Walker III is out, and Kaleb Johnson leads Green Bay with Josh Jacobs out. Either one plugs the hole. Neither one closes 43 points.

Ben's prayer is Detroit. Jared Goff (18.84) and Sam LaPorta (12.51) are stacked in that 26.5 against New England, Patrick Mahomes (18.83) is in Kansas City's 25.25 with an elbow that practiced in full, and Bhayshul Tuten (15.1) is off Jacksonville's report in a 28.5 offense. But Bijan has St. Brown and Hunter Henry (10.04) on opposite sides of that same Lions game, so Ben's best stack is half hedged. The soft spot for Bijan is Las Vegas at 17.0, where Ashton Jeanty (11.52) and Brock Bowers (16.21) play Seattle. That's 27.7 points in a sewer. It's still not enough. Bijan to go 10-0, and I'm laying it.

sections.note: God Bless Vodka. Sheev's 50.5 came from Isaiah Likely's career night, and the rest of the way God Bless Vodka outprojects Sheev 122.7 to 106.5 with four starters in 25-plus offenses to Sheev's two.
p: Both teams are 2-7. This is the toilet bowl, and it's my upset of the week, and I want it on the record that I know exactly how that sounds. Sheev projects 157.0 to 122.7, a 34.3-point favorite, the smallest number on the board. And 50.5 of Sheev's 157.0 is already in the bank from Thursday night, most of it from Isaiah Likely catching nine balls for 127 yards. Good for Isaiah. That doesn't happen twice in one week.

Here's the math nobody wants to do. Take Thursday out and Sheev's other eight starters project 106.5. God Bless Vodka hasn't played anybody yet, and its ten project 122.7. So God Bless Vodka is the better team from here on out by 16.2, and it needs to beat its projection by about 34. Is that likely? No. Is it the only dog on the board within shouting distance? Yes. That's the whole job.

Now the matchups. Sheev has two starters in Cleveland, Quinshon Judkins (10.92) and Harold Fannin Jr. (11.47), and the Browns are implied for 18.0 against Houston, tied for the fifth-lowest number on the board. Tank Dell (5.95) is the other side of that game. Breece Hall (11.63) gets Buffalo with the Jets implied for 21.25, and Zach Charbonnet (12.98) is in Seattle with Drew Lock at quarterback because Sam Darnold is out. Sheev's real juice is Brock Purdy (23.02) in San Francisco's 30.0 and Parker Washington (15.12) in Jacksonville's 28.5. That's two starters in 25-plus offenses.

God Bless Vodka has four. George Kittle (16.2) is in that same 49ers offense, so whatever Purdy does, Kittle gets a piece of. Chase Brown (13.3) is in Cincinnati's 26.4 on Sunday night, Jameson Williams (12.53) is in Detroit's 26.5, and Josh Downs (6.28) is in a Kansas City offense that just lost Kenneth Walker III. That's a lot of targets going somewhere. The soft spots are real: Justin Herbert (13.85) and Omarion Hampton (8.83) are in a Chargers offense implied for 17.0 on Monday night in Baltimore, and Tyler Allgeier (9.94) is in Arizona's 15.0, the worst number of the week. If God Bless Vodka is within 20 going into Monday, Herbert is live. God Bless Vodka straight up, and if I'm wrong, you can have my watch. It's a nice watch. It's not mine.

sections.note: Send Nudes. Panic Trade Project has two dead slots, Cade Klubnik and Carnell Tate, and nobody on its bench projects six points.
p: Send Nudes projects 154.3 to 58.3. That's a 96.0-point line, and I've seen closer fights between a man and a sandwich. Send Nudes is 7-2 and scores 174.5 a game, second in the league. Panic Trade Project is 4-5, has the league's third-best luck at +2.09, and scores 93.7, last in the league.

Start with Panic's lineup, because it's a crime scene. Cade Klubnik is in the superflex, and he isn't the Jets' starter, Geno Smith is, so that's a zero. Carnell Tate is out with the shoulder, another zero. Devin Singletary got one carry Thursday while Cam Skattebo got eighteen. Tyjae Spears (6.33) is questionable with the knee he's had since Week 7. And here's the kicker: nobody on Panic's bench projects even six points, and Jaxson Dart is on injured reserve. There's no fix. Jalen Coker (14.24) in Carolina's 23.0 and Keon Coleman (8.57) in Buffalo's 29.25 are the whole case.

Send Nudes has four starters in 25-plus offenses. Jahmyr Gibbs (24.7) gets New England with Detroit implied for 26.5. Joe Burrow (22.4) and Ja'Marr Chase (19.84) are in Cincinnati's 26.4 on Sunday night, and Aaron Rodgers (17.76) is the quarterback on the other side, so Send Nudes owns both quarterbacks in a 49.25 total. Deebo Samuel Sr. (10.6) says he's ready and isn't on San Francisco's final report, which puts him in the 30.0. Kyren Williams (17.09) gets Arizona with the Rams implied for 24.5 and Puka Nacua on injured reserve.
Mike Evans is out again and A.J. Brown is questionable, and both are on the bench, so Send Nudes doesn't care. Derrick Henry (15.23) gets the Chargers on Monday. Lay the 96. Lay it with both hands.

sections.note: brimley. Very Naughty Boys banked more Thursday, 39.5 to 29.7, but its remaining seven starters project 56.9 and brimley's eight project 116.9.
p: Here's a fun one. Very Naughty Boys is 0-9, and it banked more points on Thursday than brimley did, 39.5 to 29.7. J.J. McCarthy threw for 293, Antonio Williams scored, Austin Ekeler did Ekeler things. For one night, the worst team in the league was winning. Enjoy it, boys. brimley projects 146.6 to 96.4, a 50.2-point favorite, and it's won five straight.

brimley's remaining eight project 116.9. Very Naughty Boys' remaining seven project 56.9. That's the game. The Packers trio of Jordan Love (17.51), Christian Watson (16.71) and MarShawn Lloyd (3.33) play Minnesota in a 42.0 total, Green Bay implied for 22.4, and with Josh Jacobs out the backfield belongs to Kaleb Johnson, not Lloyd. Justin Jefferson (18.06) is on the other side of that game, with Kyler Murray out. Trey McBride (14.97) is the soft spot, in Arizona's 15.0 with Carson Beck likely under center.

Very Naughty Boys has one starter in a 25-plus offense, Dalton Kincaid (9.75), who's off Buffalo's report. KC Concepcion Jr. (10.23) and Dylan Sampson (7.42) are in Cleveland's 18.0. Tre' Harris (4.87) is in the Chargers' 17.0 on Monday. Jordan Addison (9.04) is questionable with a thumb. brimley, and the streak goes to six.

Stroke's money is in Dallas. CeeDee Lamb (20.12) and Javonte Williams (17.74) get the 49ers in the biggest total on the board, 55.75, with the Cowboys implied for 25.75 and Jake Ferguson out. James Cook III (16.41) is in Buffalo's 29.25, Chris Olave (16.36) in New Orleans' 25.5, and Travis Kelce (12.23) in Kansas City's 25.25 with Kenneth Walker III out. That's five in 25-plus offenses. Matthew Stafford (16.58) gets Arizona with Puka Nacua on injured reserve, so Stafford's throwing to whoever's left.

Jackie traded away its Jacksonville pieces, Jakobi Meyers and Chris Rodriguez Jr., on Friday, so the Jaguars' 28.5 does it no good. Woody Marks (13.13) leads Houston's backfield with David Montgomery ruled out, but Houston is only implied for 22.5 in Cleveland. Bryce Young (19.36) gets New Orleans with Carolina at 23.0. Matthew Golden (15.27) and Tucker Kraft (11.05) are in Green Bay's 22.4. Nothing here is a disaster, and nothing here is 49 points. Stroke, and I'll take the over on Lamb.

One starter in a 25-plus offense. #StopAsianHate, and somebody please wake up whoever sets that lineup.

stories.headline: Kenneth Walker Is Out, Three Quarterback Rooms Change, and Jacksonville Clears Everyone
paragraphs: Good morning. Inactive lists come out about 90 minutes before each kickoff. For the early game in Munich, that's before most of you are awake. For Steelers-Bengals, it's Sunday evening, and for Chargers-Ravens, Monday. The final reports came out Friday. As always, a designation tells you the risk. It doesn't tell you who sits.

Three league starters are out, and as of Thursday's data all three were still in starting lineups. Kenneth Walker III (#StopAsianHate) is out with a groin injury, which makes Emmett Johnson (Ben Football Team bench) Kansas City's lead back and pushes more of the passing game to Rashee Rice (#StopAsianHate), Travis Kelce (Stroke The Post) and Josh Downs (God Bless Vodka). One CBS status list still showed Walker as questionable, but its own headline and NBC Sports both have him ruled out. T.J. Hockenson (Ben Football Team) is out with wrist and chest injuries. Carnell Tate (Panic Trade Project) is out with the shoulder. Dallas Goedert (#StopAsianHate) isn't injured; the Eagles are on bye, which has the same effect on your score.

Three quarterback rooms changed. Sam Darnold (Very Naughty Boys bench) is out with rib and quad injuries, so Drew Lock starts in Seattle. That's a downgrade for Jaxon Smith-Njigba (#StopAsianHate), Zach Charbonnet (Sheev) and AJ Barner (Jackie aCHANe). Gardner Minshew II (#StopAsianHate bench) has a feared UCL tear, and NBC Sports expects Carson Beck (ClutchJuice taxi squad) to start for Arizona; that matters for Trey McBride (brimley) and Tyler Allgeier (God Bless Vodka). Malik Willis (Jackie aCHANe bench) went on injured reserve with a groin injury that progressed to his abdomen, so Kyle McCord (Sheev bench) starts for Miami, for Ollie Gordon II (Ben Football Team), Malik Washington (God Bless Vodka) and Caleb Douglas (ClutchJuice). Kyler Murray (Jackie aCHANe bench) has a Grade 2 hamstring strain and is expected to miss three to four weeks, which keeps Minnesota's offense, and Justin Jefferson (brimley) and Jordan Addison (Very Naughty Boys), in lower gear.

Two backfields changed hands. David Montgomery (Jackie aCHANe bench) has been ruled out with the groin, per NBC Sports, though one CBS list carried him as questionable; either way Woody Marks (Jackie aCHANe) is off the injury report and is Houston's lead back. Josh Jacobs (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 bench) is out two to three weeks with a fractured finger, and Kaleb Johnson (Ben Football Team bench) is expected to lead Green Bay. That's not good news for MarShawn Lloyd, who is starting for brimley. In New England, TreVeyon Henderson (Sheev bench) is out again with the illness, and Rhamondre Stevenson (#StopAsianHate bench) is questionable with a knee tendon issue, which would make Corey Kiner (#StopAsianHate bench) the lead back if he sits.

The questionables. Garrett Wilson (Stroke The Post) is questionable with the concussion, though the Jets' coach is optimistic. Omar Cooper Jr. (Panic Trade Project) and Adonai Mitchell (Ben Football Team) are questionable and expected to play. Amon-Ra St. Brown (Bijan) is questionable with the ribs he played through last week. A.J. Brown (Send Nudes bench) is questionable with the knee and ankle and traveled to Germany. Jordan Addison hurt his thumb in Friday's practice. Denzel Boston (Ben Football Team) is questionable with the toe; if he sits, KC Concepcion Jr. (Very Naughty Boys) and Harold Fannin Jr. (Sheev) get more of Cleveland's targets. Tyjae Spears (Panic Trade Project) is questionable and hasn't played since Week 7. Ladd McConkey (#StopAsianHate bench) did not practice Friday with his back, for a Monday game.

The cleared list, which is the good news. Jacksonville's final report has none of Bhayshul Tuten (Ben Football Team), Jakobi Meyers (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦) or Chris Rodriguez Jr. (Ben Football Team) on it. George Pickens (Panic Trade Project) came off Dallas's report Friday. Deebo Samuel Sr. (Send Nudes) says he's ready, and he isn't on San Francisco's final report. Dalton Kincaid (Very Naughty Boys) and Hunter Henry (Bijan) were removed from their reports. Patrick Mahomes (Ben) practiced in full with the elbow, and Jared Goff (Ben) and Justin Herbert (God Bless Vodka) carry minor chest and hand issues without a designation. Harold Fannin Jr. and Tank Dell (Sheev) are not on their teams' final reports.

Thursday is done, and nobody from Commanders-Giants came out of it with a reported injury. Elsewhere, the long-term list keeps growing: Puka Nacua (Send Nudes) went to injured reserve Friday with knee and toe injuries, Michael Wilson (Bijan) has a season-ending neck injury, and Lamar Jackson (Sheev) is likely done for the season with the thumb. My prescription is the same as last week. Check the three starters who were ruled out, and if you start Garrett Wilson, check him again 90 minutes before one o'clock.

lead.headline: Sheev Buys the Ravens: Lamar by Trade, His Rookie Replacement for $7, and Four Teams Chase Minshew
lead.deck: Lamar Jackson's thumb ran the wire: #StopAsianHate traded him and a third for C.J. Stroud and won Gardner Minshew II at $23, the league spent $49 on 12 claims, and 5-3 Jackie aCHANe heads into Week 9 with two empty starting slots.

stories.headline: One Thumb, Four Bids, $23: The Lamar Effect
paragraphs: Here's what I'm hearing: one thumb moved this whole wire. Lamar Jackson went down on Baltimore's first offensive snap Sunday, the Ravens say he needs surgery and could miss the rest of the season, and by Wednesday morning four league teams had bid on quarterbacks. Twelve claims have cleared since our last edition for $49 in all, and $23 of it went to one player.

#StopAsianHate is the team that had to move. With Lamar out, Jalen Hurts on injured reserve and Deshaun Watson a questionable backup in Cleveland, it traded Lamar and Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third to Sheev on Tuesday for C.J. Stroud. Mona Lott has the grade below. On Wednesday it won Gardner Minshew II at $23 over brimley ($17), Sheev ($8) and Jackie ($5). Minshew is Arizona's starter and goes straight into the superflex slot at 11.53, though Arizona is implied for just 15.5 points against Seattle. To make room, #StopAsianHate cut Tyrone Tracy Jr., the running back it paid $37 for in Week 6, who is now on the Giants' injured reserve. It also paid $2 for Ray Davis on Friday. It has $12 left.

Sheev went the other way and bought Baltimore's quarterbacks. It took on Lamar in the trade, then paid $7 for Joe Fagnano, the undrafted rookie starting tonight against Jacksonville, beating #StopAsianHate and brimley at $1 each. Fagnano sits on Sheev's bench at 10.31 behind Jayden Daniels and Brock Purdy, and Baltimore is implied for 14.75, the lowest number on the board. The detail everyone missed: Sheev already had Baltimore's backup. It cut Tyler Huntley on Sunday morning for Pat Freiermuth at $0, hours before Lamar got hurt. Huntley then hurt his toe in relief, brimley claimed him Wednesday for $1, and he's listed out. Freiermuth's Pittsburgh is on bye this week. Sheev is down to $3, the least in the league.

The return desk stayed busy. Ben Football Team paid $5 for Colts running back DJ Giddens on Sunday and released him Wednesday; he projects 0.18. brimley paid $5 on Friday for Jaydon Blue, beating Panic Trade Project's $2, cut him Monday for free agent Roschon Johnson, then cut Roschon on Wednesday for Huntley. Send Nudes claimed Courtland Sutton for $0 on Sunday, releasing Colby Parkinson four days after paying $4 for him, then released Sutton and Chig Okonkwo, last week's $6 winner, on Wednesday. The champs now have two open roster spots and one tight end, Tyler Warren. Sutton, for the record, was Sheev's until last Thursday, when Sheev dropped him for Tank Dell.

Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 cut Justice Hill one day after paying $3 for him. Jackie aCHANe, which lost that auction at $1, paid $4 to get him on Sunday and cut Zonovan Knight, my best value from last week, to do it. Hill is on Jackie's bench at 5.98. Bijan also paid $2 for Patriots receiver Efton Chism III and picked up Brandon Aiyuk as a free agent for Samaje Perine, a stash with no Week 9 projection. Panic's $0 claim on Jalen McMillan cleared Saturday; he's on Tampa Bay's injured reserve with a knee injury.

ClutchJuice turned its receivers over again. Last week I said it did the most with the least by adding Cooper Kupp and Kalif Raymond for $0. By Sunday night both were gone: Raymond for New England's Kyle Williams, Kupp for Bears tight end Sam Roush, and Darius Cooper for 49ers backup Mac Jones. Sheev had a $0 claim in on Williams that failed for lack of roster space. Williams starts at flex this week at 3.6. Raymond projects 7.59 and Kupp 7.21, and nobody owns either one.

So my best value this week isn't a claim. It's what's sitting there. Sutton projects 7.9, Raymond 7.59 and Kupp 7.21, all unowned. Jackie aCHANe is 5-3, plays brimley, has two empty starting slots and no healthy receiver on its bench. Raymond and Kupp are free agents, so they cost nothing. That's the most important pickup in the league this week, and as of Thursday morning nobody has made it.

Who has money left: God Bless Vodka $96, Send Nudes $94, brimley $68, Bijan $65, Stroke The Post $64 and Ben $58. Then Very Naughty Boys $26, Panic $14, #StopAsianHate $12, ClutchJuice $9, Jackie $5 and Sheev $3. Stroke didn't make a claim this week and still has the fifth-biggest budget.

stories.headline: A Rookie in Baltimore, Two Empty Slots for Jackie, and Three Games That Move the Playoff Line
paragraphs: No picks here. Jeff Longwood makes those Sunday, after the injury report settles. This is the scouting file for Week 9. Pittsburgh and Tennessee are on bye, and the only league starter it hits is Jackie aCHANe's Wan'Dale Robinson. Jackie also has Kendrick Bourne, who is on injured reserve, in its lineup, so it enters the week with two starters projected for nothing.

Tonight it's Jacksonville at Baltimore, and Baltimore is starting Joe Fagnano, an undrafted rookie, with Lamar Jackson on injured reserve and Tyler Huntley hurt. Jacksonville is a 10-point favorite and the total is 39.5, which implies 24.75 points for the Jaguars and 14.75 for the Ravens, the lowest team total of the week. Eight league starters play. On the Baltimore side: Derrick Henry for Send Nudes, Zay Flowers for #StopAsianHate and Rashod Bateman for ClutchJuice. stories.headline: The Perfect Season Ends on the Bench: How Week 10 Was Decided
intro: The league averaged 135.36 points in Week 10, up 8.88 from Week 9. Send Nudes had the top score at 190.48, followed by Ben Football Team at 187.64 and Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 at 184.96, which makes Bijan's the highest losing score of the season. The one that lost was Bijan, a 43.4-point favorite.

Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 is 9-1 and still leads Send Nudes by a game. Stroke The Post, brimley and Ben Football Team are 7-3, in that order on points. #StopAsianHate and Jackie aCHANe are both 5-5 for the sixth and final playoff spot, and #StopAsianHate holds it with 413.08 more points for. Panic Trade Project is 4-6. Four weeks remain before the playoffs start in Week 15. Here is every game.

p: Ben Football Team beat Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 187.64 to 184.96 and ended the last perfect record in the league. Sunday's lines had Bijan at 170.7 and Ben at 127.3, a 43.4-point spread. Ben scored 60.34 more than that projection, and Bijan scored 184.96, more than any losing team this season, and lost anyway.

Ben won it at running back. Its four backs scored 105.1: Emmett Johnson 35.1, Chuba Hubbard 34.2, Bhayshul Tuten 20.3 and Ollie Gordon II 15.5. Johnson was on Ben's bench in Sunday's edition, and Dr. Wang's injury report flagged him as Kansas City's lead back with Kenneth Walker III out. Ben started him, and that decision was worth more than the final margin. Its quarterbacks added 57.84, with Patrick Mahomes at 35.42 and Jared Goff at 22.42. The rest of the lineup was thin: Denzel Boston, Sam LaPorta and Chimere Dike scored 9.3 combined, and Ben still won. It left only 6.3 points on its bench, the second-fewest of any team this week.

Bijan lost it on its bench. Christian McCaffrey scored 46.3, the most by any player in the league this week, Dak Prescott 35.42, Amon-Ra St. Brown 25.8 and Josh Allen 23.34. But Brock Bowers scored 3.8 in a flex spot against a 15.12 projection, Hunter Henry 4.2 at tight end, and Jakobi Meyers 6.4. Bijan traded a 2027 fifth-round pick for Meyers on Friday and started him right away, while Ryan Flournoy scored 19.1 on the bench. Kaelon Black added 14.6 there. Bijan's best possible lineup was 210.56, so it left 25.6 points on the bench, the second-most this week. Flournoy for Meyers alone would have won the game by 10.02.

The standings change less than it feels like. Bijan is 9-1 with 87.88 more points than anyone else. Ben is 7-3 with the seventh-most points in the league, 2.55 wins ahead of its all-play record, the luckiest team in the league by that measure. That luck will be tested over the next four weeks.
Sheev beat God Bless Vodka 178.32 to 144.84, the fourth-highest score of the week, for its second straight win. Sheev was a 34.3-point favorite and won by 33.48, almost exactly on the number.

Parker Washington scored 28.2 and Isaiah Likely 27.7, and Likely and Daniels had already banked 50.46 on Thursday night. Quinshon Judkins and Harold Fannin Jr. each scored 16.1. The misses were at receiver: Tetairoa McMillan scored 6.5 against a 15.6 projection and Tank Dell 5.1, while Jordyn Tyson scored 19.0 on the bench.

Geno Smith started at quarterback and scored 5.92 while Cam Ward scored 20.14 on the bench, and Tyler Allgeier scored 1.4 in a flex spot while Mark Andrews scored 16.2 on the bench. Chase Brown (28.3) and Nico Collins (24.4) did their part. It wouldn't have been enough: God Bless Vodka's best possible lineup was 176.26, 2.06 short. It is 2-8 and has lost three straight.

stories.headline: Ben Football Team Is the Luckiest Team Alive, Bijan Lost to a Fifth-Round Pick, and I Owe Sheev an Apology
paragraphs: Last week I wrote: Week 10 has Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 against Ben Football Team, somebody tell Jeff. Jeff took Bijan. Sunday's lines had Ben as a 43.4-point dog. Ben scored 187.64, Bijan scored 184.96, and the last unbeaten team in the league is 9-1. Ben has the seventh-most points in the league and a 7-3 record. By all-play it should have about four and a half wins. It has seven. That's 2.55 wins of luck, the most in the league. I don't care. A win over a 9-0 team counts double in my heart.

Now let's talk about how Bijan lost. On Friday it traded a 2027 fifth-round pick for Jakobi Meyers. On Sunday it started Meyers, who scored 6.4, and benched Ryan Flournoy, who scored 19.1. That's a 12.7-point swing in a game lost by 2.68. Bijan scored the most points by a losing team this season and got beat by its own trade. Mona will grade the trade on value, and it's probably a good one. The lineup decision was not.

Last Tuesday I told the commissioner to start Tank Dell. Sheev started Tank Dell. Tank Dell scored 5.1, and Jordyn Tyson scored 19.0 on the bench. I apologize to Sheev and to everybody who listens to me. Sheev won anyway, 178.32 to 144.84, because Brock Purdy scored 31.66 and Parker Washington 28.2. Two straight wins, 3-7, and the sixth-most points in the league. Nobody wants to play Sheev in December. Unfortunately, at two games out with four to play, Sheev probably won't be playing in December either.

On Thursday night #StopAsianHate traded George Pickens and the injured Jalen Hurts to Panic Trade Project for Bo Nix and Emeka Egbuka. Pickens scored 43.5 for Panic. Nix and Egbuka scored 0.0 on #StopAsianHate's bench. And #StopAsianHate won by 120.1 while Panic lost by 104.48. Fantasy football doesn't care how you feel about a trade.

ClutchJuice scored 48.82, the lowest score in the league this season. Drake Maye was projected for 23.14 and scored 3.02. Two starters scored zero. Its best possible lineup was 51.24, so this wasn't a lineup problem, it was a roster problem. Meanwhile Jeff Longwood went 4-2, and his upset pick lost for the second straight week. God Bless Vodka was his dog, and God Bless Vodka benched Cam Ward's 20.14 to start Geno Smith's 5.92. Jeff, I'm not sure that one's on you.

The race: four weeks left. Bijan 9-1, Send Nudes 8-2, then Stroke The Post, brimley and Ben all at 7-3. #StopAsianHate and Jackie aCHANe are 5-5 and #StopAsianHate has 413.08 more points, which is the tiebreaker. Jackie scored 60.82 this week after trading away two starters on Friday. Panic is a game back at 4-6. If you're Jackie, you need wins, not fifth-round picks.

breakdown.headline: 1-7, Second in Value, and the Trade That Put It There
p: Sheev is 1-7 and second in dynasty value, up two spots to 68,932. It gained 2,407 since last Sunday, the most of any team in the league. It scores 141.6 a game, sixth, against the second-toughest schedule in the league, 152.6 a game. Its all-play record is 4.55 wins and its luck factor is -3.55, still the worst in the league. The projected win total is 4.3.

Most of the gain is one trade. On Tuesday Sheev sent C.J. Stroud to #StopAsianHate for Lamar Jackson and Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third. Lamar is worth 5,469 even on injured reserve with his thumb, and Stroud is worth 4,023, so Sheev added about 1,446 in player value plus a pick worth 1,083. The rest of the roster drifted down: Tetairoa McMillan lost 377, Parker Washington 328, Quinshon Judkins 309 and Brock Purdy 294. Harold Fannin Jr. was the riser, up 331.

The quarterback room is the most valuable part of the roster: Purdy (5,921), Jayden Daniels (5,749) and Lamar are the three most valuable players on the team. Behind them are McMillan (4,301), Luther Burden III (4,127) and Washington (3,769). Forty-seven percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, and the weighted age is 25.2.

The picks are where the record hurts. Sheev's own 2027 first belongs to Very Naughty Boys and projects early, worth 4,886. Its own 2027 second is Panic Trade Project's, its own 2027 third is Jackie aCHANe's, and in 2028 its first belongs to ClutchJuice, its second to Jackie and its third to brimley. In return it holds Ben Football Team's 2027 first (projected late), Jackie's 2027 third, #StopAsianHate's 2028 first and second, and Bijan's 2028 third: 8,162, seventh in the league.
breakdown.verdict: A roster built to win, a record that says otherwise, and every loss makes Very Naughty Boys' pick better.
breakdown.move: Lamar won't help this season. If a contender loses a quarterback, sell one of the three, ideally for a running back, because Sheev's backfield is Breece Hall coming off a five-week absence.

breakdown.headline: 2-6, the Most FAAB in the League, and an Early First Someone Else Gets
p: God Bless Vodka is 2-6, scores 105.8 a game, ninth, and is 11th in dynasty value at 47,538, down 733. Its all-play record is 2.36 wins and its luck factor is -0.36, so the record is about what the scoring deserves. The projected win total is 4.0.

The diagnosis is still the draft capital. God Bless Vodka's 2027 first and second belong to Bijan, and that first projects early, worth 4,886. Its 2028 first belongs to Jackie aCHANe. What's left is its own 2027 third, its own 2028 second and third, and Jackie aCHANe's 2028 second: 4,825 in pick value, ninth in the league.

The roster lost value at the top. Jeremiyah Love (4,732), 21, is still the most valuable player on the team and is on injured reserve; he lost 676 this week. Nico Collins (3,703) lost 319 and Omarion Hampton (2,775) lost 318. The one riser was Tyler Allgeier, up 434 to 1,546, and with Love on IR and Zonovan Knight out, he's Arizona's lead back this week. Forty-two percent of the value is in players 25 or younger.

One more thing for the chart. God Bless Vodka has spent $4 of its FAAB all season, and its $96 is the most left in the league. It has used almost none of it, and Collins (17.81 projected) started the week on its bench.
breakdown.verdict: A rebuild without its own first-round pick, which means losing helps Bijan, not God Bless Vodka.
breakdown.move: Sell George Kittle and Collins to contenders for 2027 picks now, and spend the $96 on young players the wire keeps producing.

breakdown.headline: Still Second, Oldest in the League, and Losing Value Fastest
p: Here's what I'm hearing around the league: nobody wants to see Send Nudes in December. They shouldn't. The champs are 5-2, second in scoring at 171.0 a game, and project for 10.9 wins. They're also second in dynasty value at 70,613, and they lost 3,012 since last Sunday, the biggest drop of any team in the league.

The drop is the price of an old roster. A.J. Brown fell 449 and is out this week, Derrick Henry fell 393 at 32.8 years old, and even Jahmyr Gibbs gave back 342. Thirty-seven percent of the value sits in players 29 or older, the highest share in the league, and the weighted age, 28.2, is the oldest. The quarterback room is Joe Burrow, Kirk Cousins (38.2), Baker Mayfield (31.6) and Aaron Rodgers (42.9). Burrow was the one riser, up 319.

The waiver work was small and didn't stick. Chig Okonkwo ($6) replaced Pat Freiermuth and Colby Parkinson ($4) replaced Christian Kirk, and both have since been released. The top of the roster is still elite: Gibbs (10,238), Ja'Marr Chase (8,336) and Puka Nacua (8,028) are three of the six most valuable players in the league.
The picks don't help much. Send Nudes owns two 2027 thirds, its own and Ben Football Team's, plus its own 2028 first, second and third. That's 6,760 in pick value, and no 2027 first or second.
breakdown.verdict: A title team with three young stars and a lot of value aging out around them.
breakdown.move: Sell one of the veteran quarterbacks, Cousins or Mayfield, while a contender still needs one, and push the 2028 first into the title run only for a starter under 27.

breakdown.headline: Players Finally Worth More Than Picks, by 333, and Three 2027 Firsts Still in the Drawer
p: ClutchJuice is 3-6, scores 94.2 a game, 11th, and is ninth in dynasty value at 51,655. Here's what changed: when this desk last looked, in Week 7, its picks were worth more than its players. Not anymore. The players are worth 25,994 and the picks 25,661, a gap of 333. The picks are still the most valuable stash in the league by 3,771.

The roster is still Drake Maye (7,492), 24, and everyone else. The risers this week: Jordan Watkins gained 624, Carson Beck (taxi) gained 417 and is in line to start for Arizona with Gardner Minshew II hurt, Pat Bryant gained 258 and Caleb Douglas 229. The fallers: Kyle Pitts Sr. lost 338, Braelon Allen 279 and Mason Taylor 259. Eighty-six percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, the most in the league, and it's the only team with nothing in players 29 or older.

The pick list, straight from Sleeper. In 2027: its own first (projected early, 4,976), #StopAsianHate's (mid, 3,277) and brimley's (late, 2,535); its own, Panic Trade Project's and Jackie aCHANe's seconds; #StopAsianHate's and Very Naughty Boys' thirds. In 2028: its own first and Sheev's first, its own second, and its own and brimley's thirds.
The projected win total is 3.7. Every loss from here helps the one pick that matters most, its own 2027 first.
breakdown.verdict: Still the league's biggest pick stash, now with a roster that's caught up to it on paper. Not yet on the field.
breakdown.move: Stop waiting on Beck and Watkins to become the plan. Package the brimley first, the late one, with a second for a young receiver who's already producing, and give Maye somebody to throw to.

p: My sources say Panic Trade Project knows exactly what it is, and Friday's trade proves it. Panic got a pick worth 1,603 for a player now worth 1,616.

The standings say 4-3. The rest says rebuild. Panic scores 95.2 a game, 11th in the league, and its luck factor of +2.45 is the best in the league. The all-play record is 1.55 wins. It projects for 4.8 wins, and its lineup this week has four starters projected under 6.

Dynasty value is 57,598, seventh, and 84% of it is in players 25 or younger, second only to ClutchJuice. Too much of that value is hurt: Jaxson Dart (4,070) is on IR, and Carnell Tate (3,485) and Emeka Egbuka (3,228) are both out this week. Omar Cooper Jr. gained 343 and Makai Lemon gained 165. Jalen Coker lost 356 and Marvin Harrison Jr. lost 302.

The pick pile is the real asset: 17,519, third in the league. Panic owns two 2027 firsts (its own, projected mid, and Stroke The Post's, projected late), three 2027 seconds (Sheev's, Stroke The Post's and Ben Football Team's) and its own 2028 first, second and third, plus Stroke The Post's 2028 second and Jackie aCHANe's 2028 third.
breakdown.verdict: A rebuild with a lucky record. The Ferguson trade was the right instinct.
breakdown.move: Don't buy at 4-3. Package two of the three 2027 seconds to move up into the first round, and keep stashing young receivers.

breakdown.headline: The Biggest Drop in the League, and a Quarterback Bought Twice
p: #StopAsianHate lost 5,114 in dynasty value since last Sunday, the biggest drop in the league, and fell three spots to sixth at 61,599. The cause is not mysterious. Lamar Jackson hurt his thumb on Baltimore's first snap, and two days later #StopAsianHate traded him and Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third to Sheev for C.J. Stroud (4,023). It gave up a quarterback worth 5,469 and a pick worth 1,083 for a healthy one.

The Baltimore collapse hurt twice. Zay Flowers lost 605, the biggest single drop on the roster, and Thursday he caught three passes for six yards with an undrafted rookie throwing to him. Kenyon Sadiq lost 240, George Pickens 237 and Kenneth Walker III 226. On Wednesday it spent $23 on Gardner Minshew II (1,162) for the superflex slot and released Tyrone Tracy Jr., a $37 claim in Week 6.

The record still undersells the team. It's 3-5, fifth in scoring at 147.3 a game, against the third-toughest schedule, with a luck factor of -2.18, second-worst in the league. Its all-play mark, 5.18 wins, says 5-3. It projects for 6.9 wins. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (10,301) is the third most valuable player in the league, behind Josh Allen and Jahmyr Gibbs.

The future is mostly spent, and the prognosis there is unchanged. Its 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice, and its 2028 first and second belong to Sheev. What's left is its own 2027 second, ClutchJuice's 2027 third and its own 2028 third, 3,667 in pick value, 10th in the league. Thirty-two percent of the value is in players 25 or younger.
breakdown.verdict: A playoff-caliber lineup with a losing record, a thinner quarterback room than it had a week ago, and almost nothing in the pick drawer.
breakdown.move: Stay in it. Its own 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice, so losing doesn't help. Use the 2027 second to buy a quarterback better than Minshew before the deadline.

breakdown.headline: 9-0, 17,872 Clear in Value, and the Same Three Thirty-Somethings at Quarterback and Running Back
p: Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 is 9-0, the only unbeaten team, and scores 184.9 a game, first by 10.4. It's first in dynasty value at 89,507, and the gap to second-place Sheev is 17,872. Its projected win total is 13.7 of 14.

The top of the roster held. Josh Allen (10,617) is still the most valuable player in the league, down 162 this week. Bijan Robinson (9,392) gained 246 and Brock Bowers (8,033) gained 216. The biggest gain on the roster belongs to Tee Higgins, up 607 to 4,439, and Ryan Flournoy gained 223. The losses are all injuries: Ashton Jeanty fell 276, Josh Jacobs 254 with a fractured finger, and Michael Wilson 249 with a season-ending neck injury.

The detail worth watching is the age. Thirty percent of the value is in players 29 or older, third-most in the league. Allen is 30.5, Christian McCaffrey 30.4 and Dak Prescott 33.3, and those three start at quarterback, quarterback and running back this week. Only 31% is in players 25 or younger.

The draft capital is the hedge. Bijan holds God Bless Vodka's 2027 first, projected early at 4,976 because God Bless Vodka is 2-7, plus God Bless Vodka's 2027 second, its own 2028 first and second, and Ben Football Team's 2028 first and third. Its own 2027 first and third belong to Jackie aCHANe. Pick value is 13,367, fifth.
breakdown.verdict: The best team in the league by a distance, carrying more age at the top than any contender should be comfortable with.
breakdown.move: Hold for the title. In the offseason, use the God Bless Vodka first to get younger behind McCaffrey before his value slides further.

breakdown.headline: 0-9, 39.5 Points on Thursday, and Two Early Firsts That Keep Getting Earlier
p: Very Naughty Boys is 0-9, scores 95.2 a game, 10th, and projects for 1.0 wins. It banked 39.5 on Thursday night, more than brimley, which I'd call a symptom rather than a recovery. Dynasty value is 55,981, eighth, up 43 from last Sunday.

Fernando Mendoza (4,429) on the taxi squad gained 516 and is the most valuable player on the roster. Colston Loveland (4,016) lost 152 and sits on a bye this week. Jonah Coleman gained 330 and is Denver's starter with RJ Harvey on injured reserve, and Jordan Addison gained 321. The biggest loss was Tanner McKee, down 718. Sam Darnold (2,371) is out again with ribs and a quad.
Sixty-nine percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, third in the league, and only 8% is 29 or older.

The draft capital is second in the league at 21,890. Very Naughty Boys holds three 2027 firsts: its own and Sheev's, both projected early at 4,976, and Send Nudes' (projected late, 2,535). It also holds Send Nudes', Bijan's and its own 2027 seconds, plus its own 2028 first, second and third. Its own 2027 third belongs to ClutchJuice.
breakdown.verdict: The tank is clinically sound: two early firsts, a quarterback prospect on the taxi squad, and nothing on the roster worth protecting.
breakdown.move: Sell Darnold and Kincaid to a contender before the deadline for anything with a 2027 tag on it. Neither is part of the next good Very Naughty Boys team.

breakdown.headline: Sixth in Value, No 2027 Picks, and Still Buying
p: Stroke The Post is 4-3, but the scoring says contender. It averages 170.8 a game, third in the league, and its all-play record of 5.55 wins is second only to Bijan Your Face 🍆💦. The luck factor is -1.55. It projects for 9.6 wins.

The value went the other way. Stroke The Post lost 2,625 and sits sixth at 65,395. Jonathan Taylor lost 795, the biggest single drop on the roster, and Garrett Wilson (401), Chris Olave (387) and Travis Kelce (295) all fell too. Michael Penix Jr. was the one real gain, up 299. Only 19% of the value is in players 25 or younger, the lowest share in the league.

Friday's trade was about Kelce, who is 37. Stroke sent its own 2027 second to Panic Trade Project for Terrance Ferguson, a 23-year-old tight end now on the Rams' injured reserve. The price was fair on value, 1,603 for 1,616. The cost is that Stroke now owns no 2027 picks at all.
What's left is its own 2028 first and third, 3,241 in pick value, second-fewest in the league after Ben Football Team. Every future move will have to be paid for with players.
breakdown.verdict: A top-three offense with an aging core and no 2027 draft capital.
breakdown.move: Win now, because the roster is built for it. Sell an aging back like Jonathan Taylor or D'Andre Swift after the season, before their value falls further.

breakdown.headline: 6-2, Tied for the Luckiest Record, and Last in Dynasty Value
p: Here's what I'm hearing: Ben Football Team is in second place and nobody's scared. The record is 6-2. The scoring is 123.5 a game, seventh, against the second-softest schedule in the league, 110.9 a game. The all-play record is 3.36 wins, and the luck factor, +2.64, is tied with Jackie aCHANe for the highest in the league. The projected win total is 8.6, because six wins are already banked.

Dynasty value is 40,281, 12th in the league, down 719. Patrick Mahomes (5,310) gained 394, Bhayshul Tuten (3,830) gained 388 and Chuba Hubbard (3,164) gained 282. The drops were at the bottom of the roster: Taylen Green lost 835 and Emanuel Wilson lost 454. The waiver move of the week was a $5 claim on DJ Giddens that it released three days later.

The roster is old where it matters. Mahomes is 31 and Jared Goff (4,033) is 32, and 31% of the value is in players 29 or older, second-highest in the league. Tuten, 23, Sam LaPorta (3,168) and Denzel Boston (2,273) are the young pieces.

The draft capital hasn't changed, and that's the problem. Ben holds one pick in the first three rounds of 2027 and 2028: its own 2028 second, 1,374, last in the league. Its 2027 first belongs to Sheev, its 2027 second to Panic Trade Project, its 2027 third to Send Nudes, and its 2028 first and third to Bijan.
breakdown.verdict: A playoff team by record, a middle team by scoring, and the thinnest future in the league.
breakdown.move: Ride it out. Spend FAAB, not picks, because Ben has $58 and almost no picks left to trade.

breakdown.headline: 5-3, the Softest Schedule, the Worst Efficiency, and Two 2027 Firsts
p: Jackie aCHANe is 5-3 and 10th in dynasty value at 48,978, down 1,842. It scores 109.7 a game, eighth, and has faced 103.7 a game, the softest schedule in the league. Its luck factor is +2.64, tied with Ben Football Team for the highest, and its all-play record is 2.36 wins. Lineup efficiency is 80%, the lowest in the league. The projected win total is 6.2.

The value losses came at quarterback and receiver. Bryce Young (3,466) lost 595, Kendrick Bourne lost 510 and is on injured reserve, and Kyler Murray (2,239) lost 241 and is out this week with his hamstring. Matthew Golden (4,148), 23, gained 232 and is the most valuable player on the roster. De'Von Achane (3,735) is on injured reserve. The quarterback room is still deep: Young, Murray, Malik Willis (2,018) and Daniel Jones.

The draft capital is fourth in the league at 14,770: two 2027 firsts, its own (projected mid, 3,217) and Bijan's (projected late), three 2027 thirds (Sheev's, Panic Trade Project's and Bijan's), its own and God Bless Vodka's 2028 firsts, and Sheev's 2028 second. Its own 2027 second belongs to ClutchJuice, its own 2027 third to Sheev, its own 2028 second to God Bless Vodka and its own 2028 third to Panic.

Clinically, the problem is the lineup, not the roster. Jackie had three starters projected for zero going into Sunday with Willis and Jones on the bench, and Justice Hill scored a 65-yard touchdown for Baltimore on Thursday from its bench as well.
breakdown.verdict: A lucky record, good picks and the least efficient lineup management in the league.
breakdown.move: Set the lineup first. Then sell one of the four quarterbacks to a contender that needs one, while 5-3 still makes Jackie look like a buyer.

dynasty.method: Dynasty score = market value of every rostered player plus draft picks. Player values come from FantasyCalc's superflex, 12-team PPR dynasty market, which covers about 400 players and already prices in age; deeper depth players get a small estimate by years in the league. Pick values also come from FantasyCalc, with 2027 firsts valued early, mid or late by the original owner's current standing. Rosters and pick ownership come straight from Sleeper. Updated with each Sunday Edition. Projected wins add the current record to 5 remaining games, played at a rate that blends all-play win rate with a strength score (half points per game, half this week's lineup projection).

tradeGrades.headline: Jackie aCHANe Sells Two Starters Within Half an Hour, and Bijan's Fifth-Round Receiver Costs It the Perfect Season
tradeGrades.intro: Four new trades since the last graded edition, all made between Thursday night and Friday morning of Week 10. #StopAsianHate and Panic Trade Project swapped two quarterbacks and two receivers, and then Jackie aCHANe made three trades within half an hour on Friday morning, sending out Chris Rodriguez Jr. and Jakobi Meyers and briefly holding Ricky Pearsall. I grade every trade three ways: value, fit and timing. Value is market price, using FantasyCalc's dynasty values for players and picks. FantasyCalc doesn't price fifth-round picks, so they count as zero here. Winning on value with the wrong timeline is still a bad trade.

trades.title: Meyers to Bijan for a fifth

sides.reason: A 9-1 team added a receiver worth 1,292 for a 2027 fifth-round pick that FantasyCalc doesn't even price. That is a value win and the right timing for a team that should be playing in Week 17. The minus is age: Meyers is 30, so this is a rental. I grade the trade, not the lineup, but Bijan started Meyers on Sunday, got 6.4, benched Ryan Flournoy's 19.1 and lost by 2.68.

Jackie got its own fifth-round pick back for a receiver it had in its lineup as of Thursday. It was 5-5 and tied for the last playoff spot when it made the trade. Two days later it scored 60.82, its lowest score of the season. If Jackie is rebuilding, a fifth is too little for a 1,292 asset. If it is contending, it shouldn't be selling at all.

ClutchJuice paid a 2028 fourth worth 797 for a 26-year-old receiver worth 1,268, a 471-point win. Pearsall is on injured reserve, which is why he was cheap, and a 3-7 team with the league's youngest core (24.2) is exactly who should be buying injured young players. It's a smart, small move.

Less than five minutes after acquiring Pearsall, Jackie sold him for 471 less than his market value. Adding a 2028 fourth isn't nothing, and ClutchJuice's pick could be an early one. But this was part of a Friday morning in which Jackie turned two players into a fourth and two fifths.

Ben gave up Pearsall (1,268) and a 2027 fifth for a running back worth 1,138, a small overpay. But Pearsall is on injured reserve and Rodriguez plays in Jacksonville with Bhayshul Tuten, who is already Ben's starter. For a 7-3 team, a healthy handcuff is worth more than an injured receiver. He scored 0.5 on the bench this week, which is what a handcuff is supposed to do.

On its own, this is a fine trade for Jackie: 1,268 in value plus a fifth for 1,138. Then it flipped Pearsall to ClutchJuice for a 2028 fourth worth 797. Graded as one deal, Jackie turned Rodriguez into a fourth and a fifth, which is a C.

trades.title: Pickens and Hurts to Panic for Nix and Egbuka

sides.reason: #StopAsianHate got 7,073 in market value for 6,860, a 213-point win, and turned Jalen Hurts, who is on injured reserve, into a healthy third quarterback for the superflex slot. Egbuka is a year and a half younger than Pickens. The cost came right away: Pickens scored 43.5 for Panic on Sunday while Nix and Egbuka scored 0.0 on the bench. #StopAsianHate won by 120.1 anyway, but for a 5-5 team in a playoff race, giving up a receiver who was in its lineup is a real price this season.

Panic took a 213-point loss and got older at quarterback: Hurts is 28 and on injured reserve, while Nix is 26. Pickens is 25 and fits a young roster, and his 43.5 on Sunday was the third-most by any player this week. But Panic is 4-6, lost that game by 104.48 and is a rebuilding team by our rankings. A rebuilding team should be the one receiving the healthy young assets, not the injured one.

trades.title: Lamar Jackson to Sheev for C.J. Stroud

sides.reason: Sheev got 6,552 in market value for a quarterback worth 4,023, a 2,529-point win, and the third-round pick came along for nothing. Lamar is out with a thumb injury that Baltimore says needs surgery and could end his season, but Sheev is 1-7 and its season is effectively over too, so the missed games cost it almost nothing. The risk is age: Lamar turns 30 in January, and Sheev gave up the younger quarterback, Stroud, who is 25. It's still the right buy at the right time for a young roster built to win next year, which now has Lamar, Brock Purdy and Jayden Daniels.

#StopAsianHate needed a healthy quarterback now. Hurts is on injured reserve, Watson is a questionable backup, and at 3-5 it is two games out of sixth with six weeks left. Stroud starts this week at 17.75 and is almost five years younger than Lamar, so the fit is real. But it sold Lamar after his value had already dropped 1,281 since Sunday's rankings, added a third-round pick on top, and the next morning spent $23 on Gardner Minshew II anyway. Right idea, wrong price.
